text: Score and Change's overview of the 2026/2027 La Liga sponsors lists Osasuna's sleeve sponsor as 'Grupo Saltoki', with Celer Lighting on the home kit and Saltoki Home on the away and third kits. Celer's own website says the Celer brand is distributed exclusively through Grupo Saltoki's points of sale in Spain and Andorra; its legal notice names Brass & Fittings S.L., of Zaragoza, as the owner of the website.
short: Celer Lighting is sold only through Grupo Saltoki, which Score and Change lists as Osasuna's sleeve sponsor.
